Privacy Policy

At HyperAuto Care, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our website or contacting us about our automotive care services.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website, request information, or communicate with our team.

Last updated: August 12, 2026

1. Information We Collect

We may collect information that you provide directly to us, including:

Name

Phone number

Email address

Vehicle information

Service inquiries and messages

Any other information you choose to provide when contacting us

We may also automatically collect certain technical information when you visit our website, such as:

Browser type

Device information

Pages visited

General website usage data

This information helps us improve our website experience and understand how visitors use our services.

2. How We Use Your Information

HyperAuto Care may use your information to:

Respond to service inquiries and requests

Provide information about our detailing and vehicle care services

Schedule or discuss automotive services

Improve our website and customer experience

Communicate important updates related to your requests

We do not use your personal information for purposes unrelated to the services you request.

3. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.

We may share information only when necessary to:

Provide requested services

Work with trusted service providers that support our business operations

Comply with legal requirements or protect our rights

Any third-party providers we work with are expected to handle information responsibly and maintain appropriate privacy protections.

4. Cookies and Website Analytics

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve functionality, analyze website traffic, and understand visitor preferences.

Cookies help us:

Remember user preferences

Improve website performance

Understand how visitors interact with our website

You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.

5. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

While we use appropriate security practices, no method of online transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

6. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, including social media platforms or external services.

HyperAuto Care is not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of third-party websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing personal information.

7. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:

Requesting access to your information

Requesting corrections to inaccurate information

Requesting deletion of certain information

Restricting certain uses of your information

To make a privacy-related request, please contact us.

8. Children's Privacy

Our website and services are not directed toward children under the age of 13.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe that a child has provided personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.

9. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, or privacy practices.

Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised update date.

10. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us.
